newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy rating lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy rating lowered.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it lowered its intermediate term investment rating on Best Buy Co Inc to market performer from outperform.
--It also lowered its EPS estimate to $1.30 from $1.35 for FY97 and to $1.55 from $1.60 for FY98.

--Citing a weak retail environment for consumer electronics products, EVEREN said in a report, "We are looking at sales growth of 15 percent or so." Previously, it expected 20 percent sales growth for Best Buy.
